request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public symbols of each kind in the non-test files under the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo package. It joins symbol definitions to their files, excludes files marked as tests, filters to public symbols, and excludes nested functions and nested classes by requiring their qualified names to contain no dot. The results are grouped by kind and returned in the order class, function, method.
sql: SELECT s.kind AS kind, CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND s.is_public = TRUE AND ((s.kind = 'class' AND POSITION('.' IN s.qualname) = 0) OR (s.kind = 'function' AND POSITION('.' IN s.qualname) = 0) OR s.kind = 'method') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY CASE s.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END
